name: IVR - Internationale Verbandes für Rechtsschutz der Binnenschifffahrt
tagline: International representation and standardization for inland waterway transport in Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: L'association a accueilli 225 participants au congrès annuel 2024 à Francfort, représentant 11 pays européens, démontrant son rôle central dans le secteur de la navigation intérieure

kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress
kpis.description: IVR Congress held May 15-17, 2024 in Frankfurt with 225 participants from 11 countries, including workshops on inland waterway safety and sustainability

kpis.explanation: Participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium on damage prevention in inland shipping
kpis.signal: First edition of recurring event addressing technical and financial risk prevention
kpis.description: First Loss Prevention Colloquium held November 4, 2024 in Antwerp with approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany covering damage prevention in European inland shipping

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with IVR member representation
kpis.signal: Pan-European organizational reach in inland waterway sector
kpis.description: 2024 congress attracted representatives from 11 different European countries, demonstrating international representation across the sector

kpis.explanation: Regular meetings of Loss Prevention Committee with physical member presence
kpis.description: Loss Prevention Committee held 3 physical meetings during 2024 to address technical regulations and prevention initiatives

kpis.explanation: Attendance and participation in European standardization meetings for inland shipping
kpis.signal: Active role in European standardization of inland shipping regulations
kpis.description: IVR participated as observer in multiple CESNI working group and committee sessions on April 11 and October 17, 2024, contributing to technical harmonization across EU member states

kpis.explanation: Number of technical guidance documents released to the industry
kpis.description: IVR published multiple new technical information sheets during 2024 providing current and relevant guidance to the inland shipping sector; exact count not specified in report

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2024 annual report.
evidence: No references to AI, generative models, or APIs in the document
